testEffect: The assertion checks only the runtime type of the result (`'number'`), weakening what would otherwise be an exact-value expectation on `applyDiscount(100, 10)`.
productionEffect: Corrupting `applyDiscount`'s arithmetic (for example returning `amount` unchanged, ignoring `percent` entirely) would still produce a number, so this test would not fail; it is expected to keep passing under that production mutation.
